user.title: Add a TV
user.description: Build the tv-nowplaying app with this webhook id (nowplaying.webhookId in local.properties) and install it on the TV.

data_description.control_entity: Power, volume, inputs and play/pause go to this entity, and the TV reads off when it does. Usually the Philips TV integration's.
data_description.artwork_entity: Its picture is shown as artwork, e.g. the Android Debug Bridge integration's screenshot.
data_description.plex_entity: While Plex plays on the TV, its poster and episode details are used.

abort.already_configured: A TV with this webhook id is already set up.
